title: 第28章 愤怒的陆沉
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
陆沉是被一阵凉意惊醒的。

    他迷迷糊糊地翻了个身，感觉怀里多了一团什么。

    那触感细腻得像上好的暖玉，带着淡淡的奶香，丝丝缕缕地钻进鼻子里。

    他下意识收紧了手臂，往怀里揽了揽。

    然后他僵住了。

    陆沉的脑子嗡的一声，瞬间清醒过来。

    他猛地睁开眼，看清了那张脸。

    玉凝。

    ？？！！

    “你你你！！这是做什么？！”

    “师兄……！”

    “别叫我师兄，我不是你师兄！！你知道你在做什么吗？！”

    “我知道！”

    “你不知道！你是……”

    “前7，我知道的，我和他已经没有关系了。”

    “那也不行！你赶紧回去，这事我就当没发生过！”

    “师兄。”玉凝没有动，只是跪坐在床上。

    “你觉得凝儿还能去哪儿？”

    陆沉咬着牙，不说话。

    “我只有你了。宝儿也只有你了。”

    “我说了，我养，并且我也不欠你的！”

    “那孩子问起娘呢？你怎么说？说他的娘是个贱人，被赶走了？”

    陆沉噎住了。

    玉凝看着他这副模样，忽然往前挪了一步。陆沉又往后缩了缩，已经贴紧了墙壁，无处可退。

    “师兄，你看着我，我不信你两眼空空。”

    陆沉不动。

    “看着凝儿。”
content_en:
Lu Chen was awakened by a chill.

He turned over in a daze and felt something extra in his arms.

The touch is as delicate as fine warm jade, with a faint milky fragrance that penetrates into the nose.

He subconsciously tightened his arms and pulled her into his arms.

Then he froze.

Lu Chen's head buzzed and he woke up instantly.

He opened his eyes suddenly and saw the face clearly.

Yu Ning.

??!!

"You, you, you!! What are you doing?!"

"Senior brother...!"

"Don't call me senior brother, I'm not your senior brother!! Do you know what you are doing?!"

"I know!"

"You don't know! You are..."

"The first 7, I know, I have nothing to do with him anymore."

"That won't work either! You go back quickly and I'll pretend this never happened!"

"Senior brother." Yu Ning didn't move, just kneeling on the bed.

"Where else do you think Ning'er can go?"

Lu Chen gritted his teeth and said nothing.

"I only have you. Bao'er only has you."

"I said, I support you, and I don't owe you anything!"

"What about the child who asked about his mother? What did you say? That his mother was a bitch and was driven away?"

Lu Chen choked.

Yu Ning looked at his appearance and suddenly took a step forward.Lu Chen shrank back again, already pressed against the wall, with nowhere to retreat.

"Senior brother, look at me, I don't believe you have empty eyes."

Lu Chen remained motionless.

"Look at Ning'er."
